Hi Karthik / Jordan,

Quick note from procurement — BrightPath needs to add an additional 8 A100-equivalent GPU instances to our committed pool for Q3, plus an updated fee schedule reflecting the higher sustained capacity. I've attached our PO (BPH_PO_3245.pdf) that references the current order form.

Can you confirm the fastest path to get an amendment in place? We need: 
- Order form that increases capacity (exhibit C)
- Updated fee table (monthly billing)
- A short SOW update for integration window

Timing: ideally a countersigned amendment by the end of next week. Please advise the internal owner and any legal steps we should expect.

Thanks,

Ethan — thanks for the clear ask and the PO. We can do this. High-level plan below and next steps: 

1) Commercial: I will draft an order form amendment that increases Exhibit C by +8 GPUs and publishes a revised fee table.
2) Legal: looping in Laura for MSA redlines related to term/termination and liability for the increased commitment.
3) Ops/Onboarding: Jordan will scope a brief SOW amendment to cover the integration window and ramp timing.

Action items from us: 
- Laura: please review the attached draft (I’ve created a first pass — proposed_orderform_redline.docx) and flag anything that needs escalation.
- Jordan: can you confirm a 3-week integration window is sufficient? If not, suggest changes.
- Ethan: please confirm whether the PO number should be copied to the amendment heading and whether your legal needs a DPA change.

I attached the initial commercial redline for speed. If we get a green light from legal today, I can send the amendment to you for countersignature and route it to DocuSign.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 08 Jul 2025 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity increase and fee schedule update (PO attached)

Karthik / Jordan — reviewing. Quick legal notes after scanning the commercial redline: 

- Pricing: confirm that the new fee table includes a clear unit definition ("GPU-hour equivalent") and an explicit minimum monthly commitment for the added capacity. We should avoid ambiguous language around burst vs. committed billing.
- Term/Termination: for a capacity top-up, recommend we preserve the existing term but add a 60-day written notice for proportional decommitment; countersigned customer acceptance should be required for any retroactive changes.
- Liability/Indemnity: current MSA has a liability cap tied to annual fees. If BrightPath is increasing committed spend materially, we should cap liability at the higher of (12 months' new committed fees) or existing cap — ask finance if this requires approval.
- SOW/Implementation: Jordan to ensure that the SOW update limits the "outage window" expectations and confirms who owns data migration steps.

I'll prepare a tracked-changes version with the clause edits and a short commentary. If we want to move fast, I can produce two artifact sets: (A) a narrow order-form-only amendment for signatures and (B) a combined MSA addendum if they insist on changing core terms. Recommend starting with (A) and parallel legal commentary to avoid delaying countersignature.

ETA: I’ll send redlines by 4:00pm today. If finance thinks the liability cap needs movement, we should escalate to RevOps before sending to customer.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.inference
